verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (headline, copy, product in its peach circle, CTA with legal underneath), but the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker is jammed against the top edge, the three-line body copy is so big it competes with the headline, and the legal line is microscopic. B has the same kicker problem, plus the Shop Sale button runs right up to the right canvas edge with no margin, the legal text wraps awkwardly onto two tiny lines pressed against the bottom, and the can is small and floats without its circle, so the right side looks cramped and unresolved.
